messages:
Alyssa: heads up — ap-southeast nodes are hitting local NVMe IOPS cap, GPU attaches failing with 'provision timeout'. saw surge after janitor scrub rolled at 03:12 UTC.
Devon: confirmed, tracing shows scrub job overlap with snapshot purge -> sustained write bursts.
ops-bot: Alert: iops_throttle_ap_southeast (avg 12k->90k) triggered on gnode-az3-*-pool
Karim: any quick mitigation? Can we pause janitor for that pool or increase iops quota?
Maria: pausing janitor will backlog cleanup and raise wear. increasing IOPS per-node is possible but costs ~+$0.20/hr/node.
Alyssa: short term: pause janitor on ap-southeast scrub-window for 30m and add a temporary iops bump to the hotpool. Who can run the commands?
Devon: I'll run. doing dry-run:
```
# cordon + evict noncritical workloads
kubectl -n infra drain gnode-az3-hot-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# set iops override
infractl node update gnode-az3-hot-01 --iops-override=35000
```
Devon: executed on 3 nodes, monitoring.
Maria: watch write latency and GPU attach success. Rolling back if tail latency > 200ms.
Karim: attach success rate improving. attach lat p95 down from 3.2s -> 650ms.
Alyssa: thanks. cost note: bumping iops on 12 nodes is ~+$57/day. file a follow-up to consider janitor rate-limiting instead of blanket pause.
Devon: opened ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421
ops-bot: Deploy bot: scrub-rate-limiter v1.0.1 rolled back in ap-southeast
Maria: plan for medium-term: add per-pool concurrency and prefix KV caching on scrub to reduce write amplification.
Karim: schedule a runbook update and postmortem. I'll own the follow-up.
Alyssa: resolving thread, leaving nodes with iops override for 45m, then revert to autoscale. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Note: reverted iops override after 42m on gnode-az3-hot-*
Maria: closing loop—GPU attach success stable. filing cost/compromise PR.
